title: VPN disconnects every hour
description: The VPN connection drops roughly every 60 minutes and has to be reconnected manually.

title: Printer on floor 3 out of toner
description: The shared printer next to the kitchen on floor 3 shows a low toner warning and prints faded pages.

title: Cannot access shared drive
description: Access denied when opening the team shared drive since this morning.
resolution: Re-added the user to the file share access group.

title: Laptop battery drains quickly
description: Battery goes from full to empty in about two hours with normal use.

title: Email calendar not syncing on phone
description: Meetings added on the laptop do not appear in the phone calendar.
resolution: Removed and re-added the email account on the phone.

title: Request for a second monitor
description: Requesting a second monitor for the desk to work with dashboards side by side.

title: Slow Wi-Fi in meeting room B
description: Video calls in meeting room B freeze because of a weak Wi-Fi signal.
resolution: Replaced the wireless access point in meeting room B.

title: Password reset link expired
description: The password reset email link says it has expired when opened.
resolution: Sent a new reset link and confirmed the login works.

title: Projector in conference room flickers
description: The projector image flickers every few seconds during presentations.

comments.text: Tried a different HDMI cable, the flicker continues.

title: License needed for data visualization tool
description: Need a license for the data visualization software to build team reports.
